data.gender_notes: Vamsi is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.

Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vamsi expresses “Little One”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: वांसि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who wields a bow and arrows

in_hindi.name: वांसी
in_hindi.meaning: वांस (बाण, bow) + ई (पानी, water, i.e., arrows) = वांसी (वादन, archer)
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who wields a bow and arrows

in_tamil.name: வாம்சி
in_tamil.meaning: வாம் (வானம், bow) + சி (சிறப்பு, arrow) = வாம்சி (வாட்டி, archer)
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who wields a bow and arrows

in_telugu.name: వాంశి
in_telugu.meaning: వాం (బోయు, bow) + శి (శీజీ, arrow) = వాంశి (వెదీ, archer)
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who wields a bow and arrows

in_marathi.name: Vamsi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vamsi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who carries the wind or one who is the little one

in_bengali.name: Vamsi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Little One
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vamsi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who carries the wind or one who is the little one

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Vedic god Vamana, an avatar of Vishnu, who is depicted as an archer. The name Vamsi is a common name in Hindu communities and is also used as a surname.
